measurement: Snapshot module graph instantiated in Node; metadata-only textures, no pixel render, no browser and no new model/art asset.

coordinates.scale: Uncalibrated local study units; do not silently reinterpret as physical metres.

reference.role: Generated auxiliary side view used only to estimate hidden depth
reference.uncertainty: Approximate skin-contour observations; hair occludes the forehead and rear jaw. Absolute depth and camera yaw are inferred, not measured.

parameterHelp.strength: 0 retains the previous depth; 1 uses this candidate. Start side QA at .65, then compare 1.
parameterHelp.noseProjection: Additional nose depth in local units; suggested tuning range -.025 to +.025.
parameterHelp.lipProjection: Additional lip depth; suggested tuning range -.020 to +.020.
parameterHelp.chinProjection: Advances the entire lower closing jaw and seam together; suggested -.040 to +.040.
parameterHelp.noseCenterX: Align the 3D nose with the original painted nose, approximately local X +.066.
parameterHelp.lipCenterX: Original painted mouth axis, approximately local X +.035.
parameterHelp.noseWidth: Nose deformation falloff width; suggested .075 to .120. Does not widen X/Y geometry.
parameterHelp.lipWidth: Lower-face feature falloff width; suggested .130 to .190.
parameterHelp.cheekExponent: Lateral cheek curvature; .25 retains the current upper-face cross section.

frontalInvariants: Original UV coordinates and reference pixels
Existing eye/mouth apertures and dynamic topology
integration: Create this volume with the original widthAt/centerAt functions.
Use frontZ for every existing face layer; keep current per-layer Z offsets and alpha seam blend.
Use backZ in backGeometry, retaining its existing X/Y rows. Both edges use boundaryZ.
Recompute changed geometry bounds/normals. Keep scalp geometry independently volumetric.
limitations: Auxiliary side depth is inferred and has not passed rendered 90° QA.
Perspective projection can change apparent frontal size after Z edits even though geometric X/Y and UV are unchanged.
This only closes the face shell. It does not fix scalp, hair, ear or body side topology.

implementation.interpolation: linear precomputed sections; exact silhouette evaluation near boundary

faceMetadata.scope: Front identity retained; blended Z profile and closed chin seam are installed for side-view QA, not yet validated at 90 degrees
